document: pre-declared secondary statistic and execution details (MATHEMATICAL_AUDIT.v3.2-followup section 3.4 and 8.5)
fixed_before: matched training starts; the screen set (buckets 95-99) has not been read
primary_unchanged: docs/EXPERIMENT_CONFIG.v3.2-followup.json evaluation.primary and diagnostic_success are applied as frozen

secondary_strict_common_cost.statistic: g_B = L_G(B) - L_C(B) at B = 0.5, each arm's NLL interpolated at exactly the budget within its own two-endpoint mixture family on the screen
secondary_strict_common_cost.policies_per_arm: four head deployment parameters: the calibration bracket (b_high_cost, b_low_cost) and two outer parameters, the representative parameter of the nearest calibration predicted-cost level with cost >= predicted(b_high_cost) + 0.01 and of the nearest level with cost <= predicted(b_low_cost) - 0.01
secondary_strict_common_cost.interpolation: sort the four policies by screen cost; take the adjacent pair c_- <= B <= c_+ with c_+ > c_-; L(B) = L_- + (B - c_-) / (c_+ - c_-) * (L_+ - L_-)
secondary_strict_common_cost.bootstrap: 10,000 document resamples, seed 20261013; every resample recomputes all policy costs and NLLs, the bracketing pair, the weight and L(B) for both arms
secondary_strict_common_cost.bracket_failure: if an arm has no bracketing pair on the full screen sample, g_B is reported as not estimable; the share of resamples without a bracketing pair for either arm is reported, and if it is positive the interval is reported as not estimable (no clipping, no dropping)
secondary_strict_common_cost.role: secondary; reported separately from the cost-tolerance primary

fixed_schedule_cost: h_gen uses one position schedule for both arms, so per-document depths and costs are identical; no cost adjustment is needed
gradient_diagnostics: already executed by experiments/chunk_depth_v32_followup/gradient_diag.py (results/chunk-depth-v32-followup/gradient_diag.json, 2026-10-13T17:10:51Z) before this file; its update and measurement use the same diagnostic documents and are reported as the fixed-diagnostic-batch one-step surrogate decrease (audit section 1.3)
execution: the primary evaluation runs experiments/chunk_depth_v32_followup/evaluate.py unchanged; this secondary statistic is computed afterwards by a separate script from calibration.json, the saved per-document screen runs and two additional screen runs per arm
not_executed: g_C (E-C against its own refitted position schedule, audit section 8) is outside this follow-up and is not reported
